runs.narrative: I was a visitor in this small, cluttered workshop. I found myself in an area where the air was thick with salt. The walls were covered in dust, and there were shelves that seemed to be filled with things I had forgotten. The door leading to the north was closed, preventing me from entering further. As I walked along the winding stairs, I couldn't help but notice the work being done below, and I wondered how much time had passed since my last visit. I took the coil of rope from the ground and began to explore, trying to find any clues or information that might reveal more about my surroundings.

I explore the shelves, checking out new titles as soon as I see them. My tasks include sorting and cataloging books, helping patrons find lost items, and ensuring that the library remains clean and organized. Despite the challenges of my job, I find it rewarding to contribute to the preservation and enjoyment of books.
